title: MOTION (PADILLA - NAZARIAN) and RESOLUTION relative to the issuance of conduit revenue bonds for the purpose of financing, refinancing and/or reimbursing…
text:
[Council File 26-1546; CD 6]
[Items Noticed for Public Hearing]
MOTION (PADILLA - NAZARIAN) and RESOLUTION relative to the issuance of conduit revenue bonds for the purpose of financing, refinancing and/or reimbursing the Borrower for the acquisition, improvement, furnishing and equipping of certain educational and ancillary facilities located at 14701 Friar Street and 14704 Victory Boulevard and a 12,500 parcel of vacant land located across Friar Street and identified as Los Angeles County Assessor Parcel Number 2241-007-027 in Council District Six (CD 6).
Recommendation(s) for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. HOLD a Tax Equity and Fiscal Responsibility Act of 1982 (TEFRA) public hearing at the City Council Meeting to be held on Tuesday, November 3, 2026.
2. ADOPT the accompanying TEFRA RESOLUTION, attached to the Motion, to allow the California Enterprise Development Authority to issue bonds in an amount not to exceed $16,000,000 to provide financing for the acquisition, improvement, furnishing and equipping of certain educational and ancillary facilities located at 14701 Friar Street and 14704 Victory Boulevard and a 12,500 parcel of vacant land located across Friar Street and identified as Los Angeles County Assessor Parcel Number 2241-007-027 in Council District Six (CD 6).
